Study ALL AVAILABLE specimens equally; UNAVAILABLE slots are absent evidence. Choose one coherent attested whole construction, do not blend incompatible variants, substitute modern Chinese, or reproduce reference brush outlines. Reconstruct original smooth centerline trajectories as a harmonious Gothic sans-serif MONOLINE drawing. Absolutely constant stroke width around 3% full canvas, round caps and round joins, precise straight bars and rounded smooth curves. No taper, swelling, brush pressure, texture, blobs, or serifs. Preserve every branch, detached stroke, counter, gap, contact and bar length relationship. NO labels, text, codepoints, frames, grids, shadows, watermark, background, multiple glyphs. U+3D20A. Four available; choose coherent THX whole construction. TOP two small detached trident forks. LEFT body long slightly curved central stem with short upper right branch, TWO detached short curved strokes flanking upperstem, and TWO detached longer curved strokes flanking lowerstem. RIGHT upper component is short centerupright crossed by shallow U/cup: leftprong curves into long horizontal rightbase; rightprong bends into center near upperpart, centerstem rises above, no closedloop. RIGHT lower assembly TWO long sinuous nearparallel courses forming narrow inner ladder with THREE crossbars and TWO enclosed white counters; outermost rightcourse forks into a further long rightdescending outerleg. Keep upper right cup separate from lower ladder; preserve left detached marks. CORRECTIVE ORIGINAL DRAWING: right lower ladder must have EXACTLY TWO enclosed white counters, NOT THREE. There are exactly THREE total crosswise rungs closing them: top rung, ONE interior rung, bottom rung. Above top rung both side courses project as free upwardcurved terminals. Below bottom rung both extend downward as open freelegs. Omit any fourth rung. Retain all other whole THX construction.
